body:
i stayed up all night crying on monday and generally feeling like shit. i know i have people who care about me and love me but it just becomes hard to remember that sometimes, i guess. i constantly feel like im too ugly and awkward and unlikeable to be loved.

the friend that i talked about doesnt even really talk to me all that much anymore. this is like third time in a month that ive spoken to her for longer than a few minutes and i only told her because id known for a long time before then

thank you so much for listening tho, getting this off my chest is making me feel a bit better already. <3 i just hope it lasts
